claims.text: A live DefiLlama snapshot taken for this research on September 1 showed a $727.4M chain-level TVL figure with $774.75M in stablecoin market cap
DefiLlama's own historical API shows $310M (July 21) rising to $711M (July 30) and $738M (July 31)
The Block reported the chain's DeFi TVL at "over $540M, up over 45% in August" as of August 17
$2.4B in bridged assets
L2Beat's independent tracking characterizes the council as a 7-of-8 multisig that can act as a direct executor, meaning upgrades can bypass the timelock delay entirely
L2Beat separately flags that critical contracts can be upgraded by an Externally Owned Account, a configuration its own risk framework associates with potential total loss of funds
The two audits that exist, ChainSecurity (Jan 2024-Jan 2025) and Anatomist (Oct 2025), reviewed "an earlier" and "a later" Ripe architecture, per the protocol's own FAQ

Ripe's own archives confirm that two components covered by its published audits - the "Juice Score" incentive system and GREEN bonds - were subsequently stripped from the launched protocol, "removed to reduce complexity" and "removed to reduce risk" respectively
The audits page's own disclaimer states scope "doesn't automatically extend to later changes or deployments" and that an audit is "not a guarantee of safety"
Hagen previously operated pseudonymously as "Dre Ham" - "And yes, I am Dre Ham. Doxxed," he confirmed both on Medium and on the @DreDotHam X account
he ran Mainframe, a decentralized messaging protocol that reached a peak market cap near $250M and listed on Binance and Upbit

CoinDesk's investigative reporting - citing former Terraform Labs colleagues - separately confirmed that Do Kwon co-founded Basis Cash, the algorithmic stablecoin experiment that launched just before Terra/UST
Ripe's own team materials describe Hagen as the person who "created the Basis Cash Discord" before Kwon's involvement came to light
Hagen was a vocal questioner of Cronje's judgment rather than a confirmed counterparty loss [re: September 2020 Eminence Finance exploit]
The token jumped as much as 1,300-1,700% in the 24 hours after that post, according to multiple trackers
then continued climbing to roughly a $200M market cap and a reported 3,759% weekly gain by July 11, before giving back most of that move to trade around $86-150M in the following weeks
CEO Vlad Tenev had publicly dismissed memecoins as a dead end on July 2; five days later... he reversed course on X - "it works great for memes, too" - and followed the token's account
Robinhood Earn advertises roughly 7% APY on USDG lent through Morpho vaults - but the underlying Morpho vault's native rate... is closer to 3.23%, per independent DeFi-market analysis

Real-world assets reportedly accounted for nearly a third of chain TVL on July 7... by July 13... RWAs at just 4.1% of value locked ($12.8M of roughly $312M total)... by August 17... the RWA share at 6%

crypto trading now represents a shrinking share of Robinhood's own business - about 7.6% of Q2 2026 revenue, down from roughly 16% a year earlier, with crypto revenue falling 38% year-over-year even as the company's overall revenue hit a record $1.31B

The SEC's own joint divisional statement on tokenized securities, issued January 28, 2026, explicitly warns that third-party tokenized exposure "typically does not convey... any equity, voting, information, or other rights"
Blast is the cautionary extreme: a pre-launch incentive campaign built TVL to a peak of $2.2-2.7B, which then fell 65% (to $745M) within 24 hours of its February 2024 mainnet launch
grinding down further to about $105M by mid-2025 and $65M by August 2025 - a 96-97% cumulative decline from peak - as its... daily active users fell from a 180,000 peak to under 4,000
versus Robinhood's own PR claim of $450M and 95M+ transactions at the same three-week mark

both companies publicly disavowed them ("we did not partner with Robinhood... these are not OpenAI equity"), and the Bank of Lithuania opened a formal review of the structure that this research found no public confirmation of closing
Immunefi... now says it protects over $190B in user funds across 330+ projects, with an average successful-exploit payout near $24.5M
Balancer, audited eleven times, lost $128M to a bug that survived every review

the SEC's own joint statement... language that describes Robinhood's Stock Tokens (issued via a Jersey-incorporated entity, structured as debt securities, confirmed in Robinhood's own Q2 2026 10-Q) with some precision
in its first week, Robinhood Chain recorded roughly $570M of DEX volume against only about $22M of liquidity - a volume-to-liquidity ratio consistent with heavy wash-trading or bot activity
Coinbase's Base, launched August 2023, is the category's clear success case: TVL above $5.6B, roughly 46.6% of all L2 DeFi TVL
Kraken's Ink is the more structurally comparable case... a single lending fork (Tydro) drove roughly 89% of a ~$503M total
